## (g) Оценка выполнимости

### g.1 Хранение и объёмы

| Объект | Размер | Default |
|---|---|---|
| Хранение fs-эталона для L1 (200 нс × 1 fs) | ~2·10⁸ кадров × 22 атома × 3 + stops | при 100fs decimation → 200 MB; fs-полная → 50 GB |
| Аналогично L3 (50 нс × 1 fs) | ~5·10⁷ кадров | 1.2 GB на fs; 6 GB на dec |
| Совокупный fs-эталон (L1–L3) | порядка 100–300 GB | управляемо |
| Хранение восстановленных траекторий | × число (system, S, scenario, model, seed) × длина | × 5 моделей × 4 S × 2 сценария × 5 сидов ≈ 200× от эталона, но только торсии → 1–5 GB |
| Inference compute | порядка | оценка ниже в g.2 |

### g.2 Inference compute (default — оценочные `wall-clock`, не требования)

> Все цифры — ориентировочные; **никаких обещаний реального запуска**, они нужны только для бюджета проектирования.

- MDGEN E(3)-диффузия: на современном GPU (A100) — каждый сценарий B (два conditioning → 100 fs-кадров) занимает ~1–10 с для системы из ~100 тяжёлых атомов; ~ минуты — для белка на ~2000 атомов.
- По 5 сидов × 5 окон × N пар × 4 страйда × 5 моделей × N систем = **порядка (1–10)·10⁵ инференсов**. С учётом параллелизма — **от десятков до сотен GPU-часов** на всю задачу. На 1 GPU A100 это **дни**; на 8 GPU — меньше суток.
- fs-MD эталоны 2.0 мкс — недели на тысячах CPU-ядер (CPU-only с OpenMM/AMBER 22). Это самая тяжёлая статья, не инференс.
- **Принципиальное предупреждение**: в среде текущей задачи нет ни GPU, ни MD-пакетов, ни datasets; план **не предполагает запуска** и не должен восприниматься как план закупки/запуска — это спецификация того, что потребуется при реальном исполнении.

### g.3 Сроки (default — ТОЛЬКО для проектирования, не для планирования)

- L1 + L2 + L2' + L3-OOD + L3 fs-MD: 6–10 недель на CPU-кластере
- MDGEN inference + агрегация: 1–3 недели на 4–8× GPU A100
- Анализ, фигуры, отчёт: 2–4 недели
- **Суммарно: 3–5 месяцев при наличии соответствующей инфраструктуры.**

### g.4 Что отсутствует в текущей среде

GPU, datasets, MD-пакеты, диск достаточного объёма, доступ к D.E. Shaw / Anton / GenBench-MD данным — всё это не предоставлено. Дизайн пригоден к запуску **после того**, как это всё появится вне рамок текущей задачи.

## Журнал чувствительности к Q1–Q6 (предположение → обоснование → как проверяем)

### Q1. Какой именно вариант MDGEN?

- **Предположение**: MDGEN = E(3)-эквивариантный diffusion super-resolution (Jing et al., 2023/2024), conditioning через Bt-temporal mask; backbone — equivariant transformer или IPA; обучение на супер-резолюшн-задаче со страйдом `S_train`.
- **Обоснование**: это каноническая модель с именем MDGEN в литературе по данной задаче.
- **Чувствительность**:
  - Протокол параметризован по `(S_train, S_eval)`: при H1 пробегаем минимум 4 значения S_eval; в анализе — взаимодействие `S_eval × S_train`.
  - Хвостовые метрики (статика) могут выжить изменение backbone; динамические — нет.
  - Если MDGEN другой архитектуры (не diffusion), baselines B0–B5 переносимы 1:1; единственное критичное место — condition-format на входе; уточняется в журнале эксперимента без изменения дизайна.

### Q2. Бюджет траекторий / источник fs-эталона.

- **Предположение**: длина ≥ 100 нс × 16 траекторий ≈ 1.6 мкс; fs-эталон с шагом 1 fs без SHAKE на тяжёлых атомах.
- **Обоснование**: 100 нс × 3–5 траекторий на систему — стандартный объём для отчётов по D.E. Shaw и Anton; 1 fs без SHAKE нужен, чтобы ловить моды от ~30 fs.
- **Чувствительность**:
  - При длине 25 нс — ACF и PSD по полосам [0.1, 1] THz остаются интерпретируемыми; полосы [1, 10] THz — только качественно.
  - При длине 10 нс — **D3, D4 не интерпретируются** (недостаточно переходов); план различает «full-design» vs «degraded-design».
  - При SHAKE на тяжёлых — **все динамические метрики пересматриваются**: SHAKE жёстко фиксирует длины связей, что подавляет моды выше ~30 fs. В этом случае полоса [10, 30] fs интерпретируется осторожно, полоса [10, 33] fs — out-of-scope.

### Q3. Целевой страйд сабсэмплинга и in-distribution vs OOD.

- **Предположение**: основная оценка на `S = 100 fs` (стандартный режим); вторичные — `50 fs` (слабее) и `1 ps` (OOD-mild); терциарный — `10 ps` (OOD-hard, для проверки экстраполяции).
- **Обоснование**: 100 fs — стандартный bridging-страйд; 1 ps и 10 ps вскрывают разную степень отхода от тренировочного.
- **Чувствительность**: метрики отчитываются **как функции S**; в T2/F3 график «деградация vs S» обязателен; при кривой деградации резкий коллапс в одной точке — признак нарушения предположения о распределении.

### Q4. Классы систем.

- **Предположение**: ограничиваемся белками/пептидами и IDP; не включаем нуклеиновые кислоты и малые лиганды.
- **Обоснование**: вопрос явным образом про φ/ψ/χ — это белковая рамка; нуклеотиды и лиганды ведут к переоткрытию дизайна χ.
- **Чувствительность**: добавление новой системы (лиганд / нуклеиновая к-та) — это plug-in через общий протокол `(b) ↔ (c)`; единственная точка необходимой доработки — определение метрики χ для нестандартных торсионов.

### Q5. Порог «восстановил» по метрикам.

- **Предположение (default)**: `T_js = 0.05`, `ε = 0.2`, `T_TV = 0.10`, `Δ_PSD_share = ±0.15` — это **предложения, не требования**.
- **Обоснование**: `T_js = 0.05` соответствует общеупотребительному уровню «визуально неотличимых» распределений; `ε = 0.2` — стандартная «20% погрешность по времени корреляции»; `T_TV = 0.10` — порог существенной разницы в марковской матрице переходов; `Δ_PSD_share = ±0.15` — стандартная полоса в спектральной аппроксимации.
- **Чувствительность**: все тесты проводятся с **3 точками** для каждого порога (например, `T_js ∈ {0.02, 0.05, 0.10}`) и строится decision matrix — чтобы одна конкретная величина не определяла вывод.

### Q6. Учитывать ли границы того, что видела MDGEN при обучении.

- **Предположение**: не делаем явного разделения по обучающему распределению MDGEN; разделяем по **физическому ООD** — IDP (L3-OOD) как наверняка вне тренировочной выборки по структурной геометрии; folded-белки с известными топологиями — реалистично in-distribution.
- **Обоснование**: исследовательский вопрос — «может ли модель», а не «при каких условиях»; строгое соответствие train/test не требуется, но и не отвергается.
- **Чувствительность**: отчёт содержит столбец `system_class ∈ {folded, IDP, peptide, deca-alanine}` с под-таблицей; любые изменения при переходе в IDP явно отмечаются как OOD-индикатор. Если в пользовательских данных есть информация об обучающих системах MDGEN — выделяем «точно-OOD-relative-to-MDGEN» и вносим в decision matrix дополнительный столбец.

## Риски дизайна и планы обхода

| ID | Риск | Что делает вывод неинтерпретируемым | План обхода |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | Неизвестная архитектура MDGEN | Не удаётся один-в-один сопоставить conditioning-format, B4 нельзя честно построить | Дизайн параметризован: все базовые сравнения (B0–B3, B5) не зависят от знания архитектуры; B4 помечен как опциональный и заменяется публичной surrogate-моделью при отсутствии доступа к точному форку |
| R2 | SHAKE / fs-эталон с шагом 2 fs | Моды ≤ 30 fs не наблюдаемы; ACF/PSD по полосе [10, 30] fs смещены | Заранее фиксируется «сигнальный потолок» `T_max_signal = 2·H_full`; все метрики выше этой частоты помечаются `uninterpretable_due_to_SR_limitation`; динамические выводы только до T_max_signal |

(1) Workspace inspection: /workspace contains only task.json and a track.md placeholder. No MDGEN code, configs, eval scripts, or reference trajectories are present. Environment is system Python 3.12.3 in bubblewrap, network disabled, no GPU, 24 CPUs, no scientific ML/MD stack installed (no torch, mdtraj, MDAnalysis, openmm visible). (2) Proposed experimental approach:
- Systems: Tiered design — (A) alanine dipeptide as the controlled benchmark, (B) Trp-cage or villin headpiece for generalization to folded miniproteins, optional (C) disordered peptide. Alanine dipeptide first.
- Reference: explicit-solvent MD, 1 fs integration, 10 fs frame save, multiple replicas (≥5; 100 ps / replica on Tier A) so oscillation statistics carry error bars.
- Subsampling: stride 1 (reference truth), stride 10 (100 fs), stride 100 (1 ps). Defer stride 1000 (10 ps) because fast-oscillation recovery there is confounded by slow-mode kinetics.
- MDGEN I/O: input coarse Cartesian trajectory at stride k×10 fs; output dense 10 fs trajectory with coarse frames held fixed; ≥5 seeds per condition to capture stochastic variance. Verify in-scope repo supports the chosen stride and windowing before committing to Tier B.
- Baselines: linear interp (Cartesian), cubic-spline interp (Cartesian), white-noise + drift scaled to B-factors, torsion-aware circular interpolation in (cos,sin) embedding, overdamped-Brownian torsion diffusion, an equivariant/SE(3) flow-matching generator if available, plus MDGEN one-shot vs autoregressive variants and an in-distribution fine-tuned MDGEN subgroup.
- Metrics (circular-aware throughout): (a) PSD via Welch, integrated fast-band deviation in the 10–100 fs band; (b) dominant frequency and amplitude recovery of φ, ψ; (c) autocorrelation time τ(c); (d) JS divergence over 128×128 Ramachandran histograms; (e) RMS error of ∂φ/∂t, ∂ψ/∂t split by Butterworth filter at 1 ps into fast vs slow bands; (f) circular mean/variance per residue; for Tier B add χ₁ PSD. Primary endpoint: PSD-integrated fast-band deviation of MDGEN vs linear interpolation across replicas (paired one-sided test, α=0.05, Bonferroni over system × stride).

(3) Consequential assumptions (asserted from prior knowledge, not verified locally): MDGEN = the Wang et al. diffusion-based traj-infill model; it preserves topology and fixes coarse frames on output; 1 fs integration yields an unaliased reference; alanine dipeptide is sufficient as a sanity tier. # 计划阶段交付（stage=plan）

文档已按要求分为四部分，严格分离：(i) 仓库/环境事实；(ii) MDGEN 方法学审视（标明来源）；(iii) 实验设计草案；(iv) 待澄清问题。**未执行任何实验**，所有"MDGEN 相关"陈述均标注为对公开文献的一般认识而非仓库事实。

## 1. 仓库与输入检查（事实层）
- `/workspace` 仅含 1 个文件：`task.json`（464 B，8 KB 总占用）。
- `task.json::documents.track.md` 的内容是单行字符串 **"Design-only task; repositories and compute are not required."**；该 `track.md` **在磁盘上不存在**（已对全盘 `find / -name track.md` 验证）。
- `context` 字段要求："Do not claim that an experiment was run."
- 仓库中**不存在**任何 MDGEN、轨迹、扭转角、训练设定的文件；与本课题相关的所有设定须由研究者提供或视为设计假设。

## 2. 环境实测（事实层）
- CPU: 24 核；RAM: 125 GiB（可用 ≈97 GiB）。
- GPU: **不可用**（`nvidia-smi` 失败）。
- Python 3.12.3（系统默认）；**无 numpy/scipy/torch/jax/mdtraj/openmm/rdkit/ase/matplotlib/pandas 等任何科研栈**。
- 网络 **不可用**（DNS 失败，pip 源无法访问）。
- 仅 `python3` 与极少系统工具可调用。

## 3. MDGEN 方法学审视（文献常识，单独标注不确定性）
- 常见管线：将轨迹条件化为低时间分辨率窗口，用扩散/流匹配生成器预测下一帧或填充段落。
- 训练数据若仅含子采样帧，则**没有任何奈奎斯特以上频率的信号能量**；去噪目标最多学帧间平滑过渡，难以凭空恢复已被剔除的快模式。
- 文献通常宣称：构象多样性、长程罕见态采样、平衡分布恢复；**通常不宣称**恢复被训练数据预先剔除的高频扭转振荡。
- 本设计解读（非文献声明）：若 MDGEN 不附加显式二面角/键长谐振正则项，则其输出的功率谱在快模式频带应接近低能平带或受插值伪影污染；如实验观察到与全原子谱一致的快振荡峰，须考察是否由物理先验泄露造成。

## 4. 实验设计草案
### 4.a 假设与可证伪判据
- **H0**：在仅以子采样轨迹为训练信号的设定下，MDGEN 输出在扭转角快振荡频带的功率谱能量恢复率 < τ、相应自相关相位/振幅偏差 > δ。
- **H1**：上述偏差均小于对应阈值。
- 占位阈值（需研究者确认）：功率谱恢复率 ≥ 70%；φ/ψ 自相关第一峰相位差 < π/8；Ramachandran 自由能 KL(真‖生) < 0.05 nat。
- 失败判据：MDGEN 显著劣于三次样条插值或谐振子高斯过程基线，或与最近邻复制差异 < 5%。

### 4.b 数据来源（设计假设）
- **沙盒现实路径**（这是设计假设）：以"谐振子 + 双井扭转势 + Langevin 动力学"在 stdlib Python 下解析合成全原子快速参考轨迹，再按 10×/100×/1000× 子采样；用解析真值谱与自相关作为"全原子真值"。
- **理想路径**（附录，不在沙盒执行）：使用公开全原子轨迹 → 子采样 → MDGEN 填充 → 真值对照。

### 4.c 基线与对照
1. 线性插值；2. 三次样条插值；3. 最近邻复制；4. **谐振子高斯过程回归**（关键对照，测物理先验边界）；5. MDGEN 消融（在沙盒中以同等规模简化扩散/流匹配模型替代）。
- 排除混淆：同一真值/同一窗口/同一采样比；推理期不允许看到未来帧；多方法做 Wilcoxon 配对检验 + Holm 修正；功效分析建议 N_min ≈ 34 个独立二面角以 0.8 功效探测 dz=0.5。

### 4.d 评价指标
- 扭转角功率谱能量恢复率 R(f)（Welch/分段 FFT；纯 Python 可写）。
- φ/ψ 自相关相位/振幅差。
- Ramachandran 自由能 KL 与 Jensen-Shannon。
- Wasserstein-1（φ,ψ）、原子 RMSD/RMSF。
- 配对 Wilcoxon + Holm-Bonferroni + bootstrap 95% CI。

### 4.e 计算预算与可行性
- 24 CPU 核 + 97 GB RAM 足够跑小至中等规模（≤50 二面角、≤10⁶ 步）的解析参考轨迹与多基线评估；FFT 与 KL 计算在小体系下用 stdlib + `multiprocessing` 可在分钟到小时级完成。
- **沙盒内不可执行** MDGEN 真实权重推理（无 GPU、无网络、无依赖）。本方案明确将"完整 MDGEN 真实评估"置于**方法学附录**，不当作实验产物。

### 4.f 假设与不确定性
1) 合成物理 ≠ 真实蛋白 MD，外推性有限；2) MDGEN 无显式物理正则 的解读需研究者确认其架构细节；3) 基线 4 自带物理先验，须配合解释；4) 训练/测试同分布条件；5) 占位阈值（70% / π/8 / 0.05 nat）需敲定；6) 下采样比与原训练设定对齐情况需确认；7) MDGEN 输入表示（坐标 / Cα / 二面角 / 潜码）需确认；8) 扭转上下文细分（α-helix / loop / 侧链）的报告方式。

## 5. 仅作说明
所有数值阈值、采样比、合成体系参数均标记为待研究者确认；不作为最终设计结论。MDGEN 行为相关的描述均来自对公开文献一般认识，仓库内不提供证据；区分清楚以避免你审稿时被"内部一致性"误导。

## 6. 待澄清的开放问题（请下一轮明确）
Q1. 目标分子类型与轨迹规模/时长；Q2. MDGEN 权重与代码是否可用，未提供时是否允许用忠实模拟的简化扩散/流匹配模型作为替身；Q3. 下采样比是否与原 MDGEN 训练设定对齐；Q4. MDGEN 输入/输出表示与是否含显式物理正则；Q5. 是否允许将"真实 MDGEN 部分"写成方法学附录、不在沙盒中假装执行；Q6. "fast timestep dynamics" 的具体所指（谱频率、滞后时间、原子涨落）；Q7. 成功判据的硬阈值（功率谱恢复率/相位差/KL/RMSD）由你给定还是授权占位值；Q8. MDGEN 论文标题/版本以核定作者对其快动力学能力的声明边界。

收到你对 Q2/Q4/Q5/Q6/Q7 的回应后，将进入 `stage=result` 交付完整设计。

## Inspect-Ahead Report (plan stage — awaiting researcher sign-off before full design)

### 1. Repository inspection of /workspace

What is present (single file):

| Path | Description | Relevance to research question |
|---|---|---|
| `/workspace/task.json` (7 lines) | Sole artefact. Contains: the question (“Does MDGEN accurately recover fast timestep dynamics (e.g., oscillations in torsion angles) missing in subsampled MD?”), the constraint that this is a design-only task, and a `documents.track.md` entry whose full text is `"Design-only task; repositories and compute are not required."` | The question itself fixes the research question and the design-only framing. The `track.md` entry fixes nothing else. |

What is **absent** — and this matters for the design:

- **No code** — no MDGEN repository, no training/inference scripts, no checkpoint files, no config YAMLs, no `pyproject.toml`, no requirements pin.
- **No papers / PDFs / READMEs** beyond the one-line meta-statement quoted above.
- **No datasets** — no alanine dipeptide trajectory, no peptide / fast-folding protein dataset (e.g., D.E. Shaw Research references, Anton trajectories, none), no subsampled variant, no ground-truth high-frame-rate MD.
- **No auxiliary mounts** — `/home`, `/root`, `/tmp`, `/data`, `/opt` are empty of MDGEN- or MD-related material (verified by `find / -maxdepth 3`). `/home/actor/` is an empty directory.
- **No track.md file** — referenced by `task.json` under `documents` but does not exist on disk; only a placeholder sentence is provided.
- **Environment note (from task brief)**: network = disabled, gpu_enabled = false, 24 CPU cores, project deps not preinstalled. This forecloses any actual training of MDGEN-style diffusion/flow models here; it does not preclude running a CPU-only analysis of MDGEN-generated or MDGEN-pretrained outputs *if* they were mounted, but nothing is mounted.

**Implication for the design document:** every concrete parameter that would normally cite a paper or a checkpoint (MDGEN variant name, training stride, atom-selection conventions, evaluation systems, dataset provenance, fast-dynamics ground truth) is — from the supplied material — **unspecified and free for us to propose**. I will treat all of those as open proposals, not as facts.

### 2. Open setup topics — what the supplied docs fix vs. suggest vs. leave open

| Topic | Brief / supplied docs say… | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) Target MDGEN variant & checkpoint, training-time stride/subsampling | Nothing in `task.json` or `track.md` identifies a variant, checkpoint, stride, or subsampling factor. | **Open / free to propose.** |
| (b) Evaluation system(s) | Nothing enumerated (alanine dipeptide, tripeptide, fast-folding proteins — none mentioned). | **Open / free to propose.** |
| (c) Ground-truth fast-dynamics data source | Nothing identified (no Anton/D.E. Shaw trajectories, no external repo URL, no file mount). | **Open / free to propose**, and constrained by the no-network / no-data environment: any data must either be described conceptually or be assumed available as an external input the researcher would supply. |
| (d) Compute/runtime | Fixed by environment: CPU-only, 24 cores, no GPU, no network, system Python, deps not preinstalled. | **Fixed by task environment.** Constrains feasibility of inference-side choices. |
| (e) Fast-dynamics proxy metric | The question’s parenthetical ("oscillations in torsion angles") suggests backbone φ/ψ torsions as the natural observables; nothing else is specified. Spectral density, autocorrelation times, J-coupling reconstruction, free-energy on Ramachandran — none defined by docs. | **Suggested by question, otherwise open.** |

For (a)–(c) and (e) I will therefore propose a canonical choice in the design while flagging each as "researcher-confirmable."

### 3. Source-grounded design sketch (high level; full design withheld pending sign-off)

This sketch is intentionally at the level of *what would be compared* and *what would control for what*, with system/metric choices left as named proposals (not as cited facts).

**Core comparison (three-way):**

1. **Ground-truth high-frame-rate MD** — frames at the fast (sub-picosecond → tens of fs) timestep, capturing torsional oscillations directly. Roles: reference moments, reference autocorrelation, reference spectral density.
2. **Subsampled MD** — same trajectory decimated by a coarse stride (the stride MDGEN was trained against). Carries the omitted-fast-dynamics information only implicitly through inferred geometry.
3. **MDGEN-augmented trajectory** — coarse frames (from 2) bridged with MDGEN-generated in-between frames, producing a fast-rate trajectory.

**Metric battery on φ/ψ torsions** (each chosen so that "fast" means "oscillation period ≪ stride"):

- Torsional autocorrelation C_φ(τ) and C_ψ(τ) and integrated autocorrelation times on the recovered fine grid.
- Power spectral density S(ω) of φ, ψ over the high-frequency band corresponding to the oscillation; compare peak heights, peak widths, integrated power vs. ground truth.
- Karplus-style reconstruction of scalar-couplings from φ distributions is **not safe as a fast-dynamics probe** on its own (it mixes rotamer population with fast oscillation); flagged as exploratory only.
- Ramachandran free-energy F(φ, ψ) = −kT log P(φ, ψ) on the fine grid — tests that mean conformational populations are preserved while not itself being a fast-dynamics metric.

**Baselines / interpolation controls (to isolate MDGEN's contribution beyond smooth interpolation):**

- Linear interpolation between coarse frames.
- Cubic-spline interpolation between coarse frames (preserves C¹ but cannot create new torsional extrema).
- Time-reversed subsampled frames → MDGEN augmentation (negative control: identical two-point statistics, destroyed dynamics, should fail any dynamics-sensitive metric).
- Shuffled coarse frames → MDGEN augmentation (negative control: destroys transition structure; any "recovery" would indicate leakage).
- Optionally: deterministic short MD-relaxation / energy-minimization between coarse frames, where applicable, as a physics-only baseline.

**Feasibility risks I foresee, given the environment:**

- **Data ingress:** Network is disabled and `/workspace` is empty. Step 1 of any real run is "obtain the reference trajectory and an MDGEN checkpoint"; neither is present. The design document must therefore be explicit that input data and a checkpoint are prerequisites the researcher must inject before execution.
- **Compute for inference:** Even on a 24-CPU box, MDGEN-style diffusion/flow sampling on proteins is brute-force on CPU; alanine dipeptide is feasible, full fast-folding proteins are not in this sandbox. The system-choice proposal should privilege the smallest viable system that still exhibits the phemonemonon (alanine dipeptide first; a small peptide second; fast-folding proteins only if external compute and a checkpoint are supplied).
- **Metric validity:** Torsional oscillations live in the 10s-of-femtosecond to ~hundreds-of-femtosecond regime. If the ground-truth frame rate is, say, only ~1 ps, "oscillations" may already be aliased and the comparison becomes unanswerable. The design must specify a ground-truth frame rate ≪ the dominant φ/ψ oscillation period.

### 4. Assumptions vs. uncertainties (kept separate, as requested)

**Assumptions I will make in the design document (please challenge any you reject):**

payload.answer:
# Experiment Design — Does MDGEN accurately recover fast timestep dynamics missing in subsampled MD?

**Status.** This is a design-only document. No experiment has been executed. After every concrete value below, a `[RC]` tag flags it as a researcher-confirmable placeholder; values without `[RC]` are derived from the supplied question, the environment block in the task brief, or the structure of the analysis itself.

**Two source-grounding notes, each flagged once.**

1. The `track.md` file referenced under `documents` in `/workspace/task.json` is **not present on disk** (verified); this is treated as a documented gap, not a blocker. Its expected content, per the placeholder string in `task.json`, is only the meta-statement that the task is design-only and repositories/compute are not required here. No further setup detail has been received from that source.
2. No MDGEN paper, release, checkpoint, system specification, force field, dataset, or numerical result has been inspected. The concept of a generative diffusion/flow model bridging gaps between coarse MD frames is used here only as a literature-motivated framing of the design, not as a citation.

---

## 1. Rationale

Substrate molecular-dynamics trajectories are typically saved at coarser intervals than the fast dihedral oscillations of the backbone occur on. Backbone φ, ψ torsions oscillate on timescales well below what most "save-every-N-steps" MD pipelines record; the result is that for any saved coarse trajectory, the in-segment torsional time series is either missing or aliased, so any analysis of torsional oscillations must somehow infer or generate what is not on disk. The idea behind MDGEN-style generative bridging is that a learned model can fill the missing time-resolution in a way that, in principle, approximates the underlying physical dynamics rather than merely smoothing.

The question of interest is narrow: *does such bridging actually recover the missing fast oscillation content?* Because the ground-truth dynamics are continuous but the comparison is masked to a coarse observation regime, the experiment must (i) use a ground truth saved at a frame rate far shorter than the dominant oscillation period, so oscillation is recorded rather than aliased; (ii) apply a non-trivial set of baselines that share the same coarse inputs but cannot by construction reproduce fast oscillations, so any recovery is attributable beyond geometric interpolation; and (iii) include controls that share the same coarse *statistics* but destroy the temporal order, so any recovery is attributable beyond two-point distrbution memorization. Torsional autocorrelation and power spectral density are the natural observables because both are direct unbiased readouts of the fast oscillation content and are defined purely in terms of φ, ψ time series at the recovered fine grid.

---

## 2. Research question, restated as falsifiable claims

The original question decomposes into three falsifiable claims. Each is paired with what would be measured and what would constitute evidence for or against it.

**C1. Oscillation-presence claim.** There exists a band of angular frequencies ω in the high-frequency regime of the torsional PSD — specifically above the Nyquist frequency of the coarse stride — at which the PSD of φ (and analogously ψ) on MDGEN-augmented trajectories has finite, non-noise integrated power, while the corresponding PSD on the subsampled trajectory has none (by Nyquist, the power is absent because the signal is unrecorded, not because it does not exist). *Evidence for C1:* a clearly resolved peak in S_φ(ω) at the same angular frequency as in the ground-truth PSD, with relative-height ratio above a pre-registered threshold `[RC]`. *Evidence against:* the MDGEN PSD in that band is indistinguishable from noise or from the subsampled-aliased baseline.

**C2. Frequency-localization claim.** When C1 holds, the peak frequency of S_φ(ω) on MDGEN-augmented trajectories matches the ground-truth peak frequency within a pre-registered tolerance `[RC]` (the tolerance is set relative to the bandwidth of the ground-truth peak, e.g. ± one FWHM). *Evidence against:* the peak is at a shifted frequency, broader than ground truth by more than `[RC]`, or split into multiple peaks.

**C3. Attribution claim.** Both C1 and C2 hold specifically because of MDGEN's generative structure — not because smooth geometric interpolation between coarse frames happens to look noiseless at fine scales, and not because the model is merely matching marginal or pairwise structural statistics. *Evidence for C3:* the four baselines/controls listed in §6 collectively fail C1 and C2 in the predicted ways (§6.2), while MDGEN passes them. *Evidence against:* any of linear/spline interpolation passes C1 (would indicate MDGEN gives no benefit beyond interpolation) or shuffled MDGEN passes C1 (would indicate the model is not using temporal conditioning).

The question is judged affirmative only if all three claims hold jointly.

---

## 3. Hypotheses

**Primary.**
- **H1.** *MDGEN-augmented trajectories recover the high-frequency torsional oscillation content of φ and ψ that is absent from subsampled trajectories.*

**Primary nulls (paired with their respective controls).**
- **H0_lin.** Linear interpolation between coarse frames does **not** recover the oscillation band (§6.2.1).
- **H0_spl.** Cubic-spline interpolation does **not** recover the oscillation band (§6.2.2).
- **H0_rev.** MDGEN run on time-reversed coarse frames has the same coarse-frame joint statistics and the same marginal φ, ψ distributions but, to the extent that MDGEN encodes genuine forward-time dynamics, its oscillation-band PSD should differ from forward-time MDGEN (predicted signature in §6.2.3).
- **H0_shf.** MDGEN run on coarse frames shuffled in time has the same marginal φ, ψ statistics but losstemporal structure; predicted to fail C1 in the oscillation band (§6.2.4).

**Secondary.**
- **H2.** *Degradation of C1/C2 coverage as the coarse stride increases is graceful rather than catastrophic*, so that at strides below and at the MDGEN training stride recovery holds, and the failure pattern is monotone in stride.
- **H3.** *Overall torsional free-energy structure is preserved by MDGEN augmentation.* The Ramachandran free energy F(φ, ψ) on MDGEN-augmented trajectories agrees with ground truth on the populated regions within a pre-registered tolerance `[RC]`.

**Negative expectation that must be checked.**
- **N1.** *MDGEN augmentation does not artificially flatten fast oscillations.* If MDGEN were producing frames that look "diffused" at the fine scale, C1 would spuriously appear to fail while C3 might still pass.

---

## 4. Conditions

### 4.1 Three-way primary comparison

For each trajectory segment of length L at the ground-truth frame rate Δt_gt, the experiment produces three parallel fine-rate time series at the same effective frame rate:

1. **Ground truth.** φ, ψ extracted from the original fine-rate trajectory at Δt_gt.
2. **Subsampled.** Coarse frames taken every N · Δt_gt frames (N from the stride sweep, §4.3); within each coarse interval, φ, ψ values at the fine grid are *not* available — by construction they would have to be inferred.
3. **MDGEN-augmented.** The coarse frames (every N · Δt_gt frames) are passed to MDGEN; MDGEN samples the in-between frames; φ, ψ are extracted from the resulting fine-rate trajectory at Δt_aug = Δt_gt (so the same downstream metrics can be applied). This is the strict, replicable recipe; alternative choices (different Δt_aug, different conditioning density) are deferred to the researcher's discretion.

### 4.2 Tiered systems

| Tier | System | Role | In-sandbox? |
|---|---|---|---|
| **T1 (primary, must-execute)** | Alanine dipeptide (ACE-ALA-NME or equivalent capped alanine, vacuum or explicit solvent per study convention `[RC]`) | Cheapest system on which φ, ψ oscillations are physically meaningful and (in vacuum/low friction) effectively decoupled. Acts as the gatekeeper for the methodology. | Yes, with the feasibility checks in §8. |
| **T2 (secondary)** | A short unstructured or minimally structured peptide `[RC]` (e.g., a 3–10 residue peptide without stable secondary structure) | Adds the effect of neighboring-residue couplings on φ/ψ dynamics; cheap enough on CPU. | Yes. |
| **T3 (contingent)** | One or more fast-folding proteins (specific identity `[RC]`) | Realistic-system test if external compute and a checkpoint are provided. | **Out of sandbox**; design is scoped but execution is contingent on §9 inputs. |

All three tiers test the same falsifiable claims, C1–C3, so a positive result that survives across tiers is the intended robustness criterion.

### 4.3 Stride sweep

- **Anchor.** The MDGEN training stride `[RC]` (kept nominal until the checkpoint is supplied). One full sweep point at this stride.
- **Finer.** At least one stride strictly less than the anchor, e.g., anchor/[RC] e.g., × 1/10 `[RC]`. Confirms behaviour as stride tightens toward the training distribution.
- **Coarser.** At least one stride strictly greater than the anchor, e.g., anchor × [RC] e.g., × 10 `[RC]`. Confirms graceful or catastrophic degradation.
- **Ground-truth frame rate Δt_gt.** Held fixed across the entire sweep and **must satisfy the binding feasibility constraint of §8.1** before any data acquisition. Placeholder value: 1 fs, i.e., oscillation period > a comfortable multiple of saved-frame interval `[RC]`.

The sweep is the experimental substrate for **H2**.

---

## 5. Metrics

Notation used throughout. Let φ_t denote the φ value at frame index t on the *fine-rate* time series of any of the three conditions; μ_φ = ⟨φ_t⟩, σ_φ² = ⟨(φ_t − μ_φ)²⟩ (sample means/variances over a trajectory segment). All metrics are computed per independent trajectory segment, then aggregated (see §7).

### 5.1 Torsional time series at the fine grid

Inputs: for each segment of the ground-truth trajectory, the tor t∈{0,…,T−1}. For the subsampled condition, only φ_{t_k} at k=0,1,…,T/N are observed; the "fine grid" values at intermediate t are undefined by construction and an attempt to apply the metrics below to subsampled alone is a Nyquist violation that the experiment labels as such. For MDGEN-augmented, φ_t at every fine frame is the dihedral of the MDGEN-sampled structure; bonds/backbones are wrapped using whatever convention MDGEN adopts (i.e., dihedral angle convention consistent with the reference MD engine).

### 5.2 Autocorrelation (primary)

For each torsional series φ_t (and analogously ψ_t) on the fine grid,

```
C_φ(τ) = ⟨(φ_t − μ_φ)(φ_{t+τ} − μ_φ)⟩ / σ_φ²,  τ = 0, 1, …, τ_max
```

where ⟨·⟩ is a time average (and for each segment, separately normalized by that segment's σ_φ). Per-segment estimates are computed; cross-segment means and block-bootstrap confidence bands are reported per §7. Reporting points: τ = 0 (≡1, sanity), τ at the *ground-truth* oscillation half-period, τ equal to the coarse stride N·Δt_gt (a regime where subsampled alone carries no information between coarse frames), and τ up to ~20× the coarse stride.

### 5.3 Power spectral density (primary)

S_φ(ω) is the periodogram of φ_t − μ_φ computed on each segment:

```
S_φ(ω_k) = |Σ_t (φ_t − μ_φ) e^{−i ω_k t}|² / (T · Δt_aug · σ_φ²),   ω_k = 2π k / (T Δt_aug)
```

with frequency normalization by σ_φ² to make the spectrum dimensionless and comparable across segments. Welch-style segment-averaging (Welch window `[RC]`, segment overlap `[RC]`) is used per segment; cross-segment averaging is then over the resulting per-segment spectra.

### 5.4 Oscillation-band integrated power (primary)

Definition of the band is data-driven and pre-registered: from the *ground-truth* spectrum S^gt_φ(ω), identify the dominant high-frequency peak above a frequency floor f_min `[RC]` Hz (chosen to lie clearly above the coarse-stride Nyquist frequency), and take the band as ω ∈ [ω_peak − Δ, ω_peak + Δ] where Δ equals one ground-truth FWHM `[RC]` (or an absolute width `[RC]`, whichever is easier to bound). Integrated power in the band is

```
P_φ = ∫_{band} S_φ(ω) dω.
```

The per-condition band-integrated power ratio R_φ = P_φ^{condition} / P_φ^{ground} is the headline number for **C1**.

### 5.5 Quantitative lag-window bounds (secondary, paired with qualitative)

Choose a lag window τ ∈ [0, τ_window] where τ_window = [RC] × 20 · N · Δt_gt `[RC]`. Define

```
ε_φ = (1/|W|) · ∫_{τ∈W} |C_φ^{condition}(τ) − C_φ^{gt}(τ)| dτ
```

and report the ratio (or relative L1) ε_φ / ‖C_φ^{gt}‖_1. Same for ψ. Pre-registered acceptable bound: ε_φ below `[RC]`. This is the quantitative counterpart of §2 C1/C2 and is the operationalization of "shape agreement within tolerance" required by the qualitative metric.

### 5.6 Ramachandran free energy (population-level sanity, **H3**)

`F(φ, ψ) = −kT ln P(φ, ψ)`, with P estimated by 2-D histogram binning on the fine grid over a trajectory segment (per-condition, per-segment). Reported as F-condition vs. F-gt over the densely populated region (defined as the set of (φ, ψ) bins where the ground-truth probability is above a threshold `[RC]`). This is a stratification check and is **explicitly not** a fast-dynamics metric — the brief calls it out as a population-level sanity only.

### 5.7 Time-reverse bispectrum (control-supporting, optional)

For systems where forward/reverse dynamics might still be detectable, a bispectrum of φ and ψ can flag lost time-asymmetry. Optional, de-prioritized if the autocorrelation evidence is already conclusive.

---

## 6. Baselines and negative controls

### 6.1 Baselines (predict smooth interpolation, must fail C1)

#### 6.2.1 Linear interpolation (LI)

Construction: between coarse frames φ_{t_k} and φ_{t_{k+1}}, φ_t = φ_{t_k} + (φ_{t_{k+1}} − φ_{t_k})(t − t_k)/(t_{k+1} − t_k). Effective fine-rate φ at every integer frame t. Applied to φ and ψ.

**Predicted behaviour.** C_φ(τ) within any one coarse interval is exactly the linear segment's autocorrelation: a single-peaked, segment-monotone shape with no high-frequency oscillation. P_φ in the oscillation band → 0 (or to a numerical-floor noise level determined by the variance across coarse intervals). Test: LI should fail C1 by a wide margin; that margin is the headroom MDGEN must exceed.

#### 6.2.2 Cubic-spline interpolation (CI)

Construction: piecewise cubic spline through coarse φ values, with derivative boundary conditions per the chosen convention (natural or not-a-knot `[RC]`).

**Predicted behaviour.** Within a coarse interval, spline interpolation produces a single smooth segment with at most one local extremum; no oscillation. Marginal improvement over LI in mean squared error, no genuine improvement on oscillation-band power. Test: CI should also fail C1, and the LI-vs-CI gap should be small in the oscillation band (because both fail). This is the joint claim of §6 — both fail, but they fail differently at low frequencies.

### 6.3 Generative controls (predict forward-dynamics-sensitive vs not)

#### 6.3.3 Time-reversed coarse frames → MDGEN (REV)

Construction: take the coarse frames in original order t_0, t_1, …, t_K. Form the reversed sequence t_K, t_{K−1}, …, t_0, and run MDGEN bridging on it. The joint distribution of individual coarse frames is identical to the forward case; the temporal order is reversed.

**Predicted behaviour.** C_φ(τ) is by construction symmetric in τ (C_φ(τ) = C_φ(−τ)), so REV's autocorrelation at positive lags will approximately match the forward MDGEN's. Therefore REV is only a *weak* control on autocorrelation. **Honest limitation documented:** REV is included for completeness and as a joint check with the optional bispectrum (§5.7); it should not be relied upon in isolation. The relevant output of this control is to confirm that the primary metric is symmetric in time-reversal (a sanity check that the metric is well-defined).

#### 6.3.4 Shuffled coarse frames → MDGEN (SHF)

Construction: randomly permute the coarse frame indices; pass the shuffled sequence to MDGEN as if it were a real trajectory.

**Predicted behaviour.** Coarse-frame marginal and pairwise statistics are preserved by permutation; the per-segment power spectral density of MDGEN output on a *shuffled* coarse conditioning is predicted to lose definition because MDGEN's bridging depends on consecutive coarse frames. P_φ in the oscillation band is predicted to be lower than forward MDGEN if MDGEN genuinely uses temporal conditioning (some residual may remain if MDGEN regenerates fine frames conditioned only on a single coarse frame's neighborhood). Test: SHF must fail C1 to confirm that MDGEN is using the temporal order; otherwise §2 C3's "not memorization" claim is unsupported.

### 6.4 Optional: physics baseline (deferred)

A deterministic MD-relaxation or energy minimization between consecutive coarse frames, using the supplied force field. System-dependent cost; for alanine dipeptide it is cheap. Predicted behaviour: produces a smooth relaxation trajectory that should fail C1 by the same logic as LI/CI (no oscillation). Included only if cost is negligible.

### 6.5 Attribution logic (updated A3)

No single baseline or control is dispositive. The four baselines/controls are evaluated jointly:

- LI and CI together confirm that recovery is *not* a free consequence of any smooth interpolation.
- SHF confirms recovery is *not* a free consequence of matching marginal or pairwise structural statistics.
- REV is a sanity check that the primary metric is time-symmetric where it should be.

C3 (the attribution claim) is judged to hold only if **MDGEN passes C1–C2 while LI, CI, and SHF each fail C1** (REV is allowed to behave like MDGEN on autocorrelation, as expected).

---

## 7. Analysis plan

### 7.1 Per-metric comparison procedure

For each trajectory system × stride × independent segment, compute φ, ψ spect tra at the fine grid, derive C_φ(τ), C_ψ(τ), S_φ(ω), S_ψ(ω), P_φ, P_ψ, ε_φ, ε_ψ, F(φ, ψ), and per-condition band ratios. Aggregate across segments by computing per-system, per-stride sample mean and block-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.

### 7.2 Sample-size sketch

Per-segment variabilities of C_φ(τ), S_φ(ω), and P_φ are unknown *a priori*, since no claimable reference numbers exist here. Sketch: for a chosen-effect-on-band-power Δ = (P_φ^{gen} − P_φ^{shuf}) / σ, with σ estimated from a pilot of `[RC]` independent segments per tier, the standard paired-difference formula at two-sided α = 0.05, power 0.8, gives a per-tier sample size N_seg that is part of the analysis output; the design treats this as an analytic computation rather than a pre-committed number. Sections §7.3 and §7.4 turn the sample-size estimate into the actual pre-registration.

### 7.3 Statistical tests for paired time series

- *Per-lag, per-physical-pair comparison of C_φ(τ):* paired block bootstrap (block = coarse-interval for autocorrelation; block = segment for PSD) to produce 95% CIs on the mean difference; report the lag-window CIs as the operationalization of ε.
- *PSD-band power:* paired bootstrap on per-segment integrated power (P_φ^{condition} − P_φ^{gt}); same for ψ.
- *Frequency-localization (C2):* paired bootstrap on the peak frequency ω_peak derived from each segment's spectrum; the tolerance `[RC]` is reported as a CI on (ω_peak^{gen} − ω_peak^{gt}).
- *Ramachandran (H3):* paired bootstrap on per-binned log-probability differences over the populated bin mask.

Tests are paired because each MDGEN-augmented segment has a matched ground-truth segment (same trajectory origin, different bridging), so the paired structure is automatic.

### 7.4 Pre-registration of what counts as "recovery"

A condition × system × stride is judged to **recover** fast torsional dynamics jointly and only if all the following hold on the per-segment paired estimates:

1. *C1 — oscillation presence:* the lower 95% CI on R_φ = P_φ^{gen} / P_φ^{gt} in the oscillation band is above `[RC]` (e.g., fraction of ground-truth integrated power) **and** the lower 95% CI on R_φ − R_φ^{LI} is positive in the same band (i.e., MDGEN exceeds linear interpolation).
2. *C2 — frequency localization:* the 95% CI on the difference ω_peak^{gen} − ω_peak^{gt} contains 0 and is contained within ± `[RC]` FWHM (or absolute tolerance).
3. *C3 — attribution:* LI, CI, and SHF each individually show lower-bound CIs on their R· below `[RC]` in the oscillation band, while MDGEN satisfies (1). REV is reported separately for the symmetry sanity check.

Across tiers the design declares an affirmative answer to the original question if C1–C3 hold at the anchor stride on T1 (alanine dipeptide, primary) and at minimum on T2; T3 is reported as a contingent extension.

---

## 8. Feasibility checks (gates before execution)

### 8.1 Binding ground-truth frame-rate constraint (added A7)

Pre-execution check, must pass before any data acquisition. Compute φ, ψ spectrograms on a short pilot of the ground-truth trajectory at the candidate Δt_gt and identify the dominant torsional oscillation period T_osc. Pass if T_osc > `[RC]` × Δt_gt (e.g., × 20, comfortably above Nyquist and above any minimum sampling for oscillation frequency resolution). Fail otherwise; in which case the study is not answerable on that dataset at that Δt_gt and a finer-Δt_gt reference is required. Documented as a hard gate rather than a tunable parameter.

### 8.2 CPU-vs-GPU cost per tier

- **T1 (alanine).** Per coarse-stride fine-rate trajectory segment of length L_gt `[RC]` ps, MDGEN sampling `[RC]` frames between consecutive coarse anchors. Approximate order-of-magnitude cost in CPU-hours/segment is `[RC]` (e.g., 0.1–10) at the most inexpensive `MDGEN` setting consistent with §9. Aggregate across the stride sweep and `[RC]` segments becomes a wall-clock plan;
- **T2 (peptide).** Cost scales roughly with the number of atoms; within reach of the sandbox at `[RC]` segments per stride (TBC after benchmark in §8.3 below);
- **T3 (protein).** Out-of-sandbox; execution requires external compute and the §9 inputs.

### 8.3 Dependency footprint and benchmarking plan

Local feasibility check (per the researcher's scoping decision): a *tiny synthetic two-atom demo* of the metric definitions (LI, CI, autocorrelation, PSD, band-integrated power, paired bootstrap) on simulated noisy torsions, to confirm that the analysis pipeline produces matching C1/C2 results against a known closed-form oscillation + noise mixture. This is the only computation the sandbox is required to execute and is independent of MDGEN availability. Cost: minutes.

### 8.4 Other gating checks

- Trajectory length sufficient for PSD resolution at the lowest ω of interest (FFT resolution Δω = 2π / (T Δt_aug); requirement: oscillation-peak FWHM ≥ `[RC]` × Δω).
- Segment independence assumption (decorrelation of φ, ψ across segments over the longest τ_window sampled); if violated, increase segment length or shorten τ_window.
- Per-condition sample-size estimate (§7.2) returns a feasible number of segments per tier.

## 1. Repository / environment inspection (concrete findings)

**Workspace contents (`/workspace`):**
- Only `task.json` is present (`511` bytes). No source code, no checkpoints, no datasets.
- No SiT, Hyena, or transformer reference implementation in the repo.
- No `pip` cached wheels for `torch`, `einops`, `numpy`, `scipy`, `huggingface_hub`, etc.

**System environment (observed):**
- Python 3.12.3, `pip3` present at `/usr/bin`, `nvidia-smi` binary exists.
- 24 CPU cores, 125 GiB RAM, ~61 GiB swap, network disabled (bubblewrap).
- Per task spec: GPU is **not enabled** for compute, no dataset is pre-staged, project deps are **not** preinstalled.

**Missing for an SiT+Hyena design (catalogued, not invented):**
- A SiT reference implementation (interpolant + axial space/time attention).
- A Hyena operator implementation (causal + non-causal variants).
- Long-horizon multi-timescale trajectory data (physical systems, video, or synthetic ODE suite).
- Compute budget, wall-clock budget, and chosen seed plan are unspecified.

The repository observation supports a **design-only** deliverable. No experiment is run; runtime/profiling evidence is infeasible here.

---

## 2. Proposed experimental design (design-only; outcomes not predicted)

### 2.1 Research question refinement — testable hypotheses

**Primary question:** Does replacing the **time-axis attention** in SiT with a **non-causal Hyena operator** improve long-horizon trajectory consistency and multi-timescale fidelity vs. the original time-attention SiT, given matched parameters, data, and optimizer steps?

Operationally broken into four testable, falsifiable hypotheses:

| ID | Hypothesis | Decision rule (no prediction of result) |
|---|---|---|
| **H1 (consistency)** | *Hyena-SiT rollout NRMSE 4× training horizon ≤ SiT rollout NRMSE 4× training horizon.* | Reject H1 if mean NRMSE ratio (Hyena/SiT) > 1 across ≥3 seeds with paired bootstrap 95% CI excluding 1. |
| **H2 (multi-scale spectral fidelity)** | *Hyena-SiT per-band (low/mid/high-octave) log-power-spectrum L1 error ≤ SiT.* | Reject H2 if Hyena is significantly worse in ≥1 of 3 bands (paired permutation test, Holm-corrected). |
| **H3 (long-horizon generalization)** | *Hyena-SiT's relative error growth per extra rollout step (empirical Lyapunov-style slope) ≤ SiT's.* | Reject H3 if fitted log-error slope > SiT's across all sequence lengths tested. |
| **H4 (operator-necessity)** | *The non-causality is the active ingredient — a causal Hyena variant does not match H1/H2.* | Accept H4 if causal Hyena fails H1 with no overlap in 95% CIs vs. non-causal Hyena. |

These four hypotheses together answer "does the operator change help, where in frequency space does it help, does it survive length extrapolation, and is non-causality doing the work?" They do **not** pre-commit to a winner.

### 2.2 Architectural change — where Hyena plugs in and how non-causality is handled

**SiT background (what stays the same across all conditions):**
- Stochastic interpolant backbone with `x_t = (1−t)·x_0 + t·x_1` parameterization (or the GM variant SiT uses; this is recorded as a setup-4 detail to confirm).
- Patch-embedding of frame $x_t$ into $N_s$ spatial tokens per timestep.
- **Spatial blocks** intermix with **time blocks**. Spatial blocks apply self-attention **within** each timestep across spatial tokens. Time blocks apply self-attention **across** the temporal axis treating each (frame, channel) pair as a token.
- AdaLN-zero conditioning used in SiT; class/latent-conditioning and timestep embeddings unchanged in all runs.

**The substitution (treatment):**
- Replace the **time-axis self-attention** operator inside time blocks with a **non-causal Hyena operator** while keeping:
  - Residual stream order and normalization positions,
  - The MLP between attention and the next block,
  - Spatial blocks unchanged,
  - Initialization scale matched to the attention baseline to keep optimization dynamics comparable.

**Non-causality realization (one of two equivalent forms — pick and lock):**
1. **Bidirectional Hyena.** Two-depth implicit convolution kernel $h$ of length $L_k$ applied as: $y = \mathrm{Conv1d}_{\text{fwd}}(g_1 \odot \mathrm{Conv1d}_{\text{fwd}}(u)) + \mathrm{Conv1d}_{\text{bwd}}(g_2 \odot \mathrm{Conv1d}_{\text{bwd}}(u))$, with $g_i$ learned elementwise gates. Both directions process the entire sequence; output is element-sum of forward and backward branches — matching a non-causal convolutional operator at sub-quadratic cost.
2. **Two-causal-Hyena sum.** A forward causal Hyena + a reverse-time causal Hyena summed; equivalent to option (1) in expectation under time-reversal symmetry of the data distribution, but easier to debug against literature code.

Lock the choice at design time (recommendation: option (1), since it is the canonical "non-causal Hyena" construct discussed in follow-up work to Poli et al. 2023). Treat option (2) as a fall-back if (1) has stability issues.

**Position encoding.** SiT does not rely on rotary position embeddings inside time blocks; it uses absolute timestep embeddings. Hyena uses **no** positional bias inside the convolution; explicitly verify this is consistent with how time index information reaches the operator (via the conditioning path / AdaLN, not via position embedding).

### 2.3 Baseline controls (at minimum)

| Condition | Time-block operator | Causal? | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SiT-attn` (referent) | Standard multi-head self-attention across time, as in SiT | No (bidirectional) | Primary control — required |
| `SiT-hyena-NC` | Non-causal Hyena (this proposal) | No | Treatment |
| `SiT-hyena-C` | Causal Hyena (HyenaDNA-style, with a causal mask inside the gated conv) | Yes | Necessity-of-non-causality ablation (tests H4) |
| `SiT-mamba` *(optional, if compute permits)* | Mamba-1 / Mamba-2 block in the time slot | Yes | Modern SSM causal baseline showing what state-space models buy, isolating the non-causality contribution |

Match: parameter budget (≤ ±5% relative difference at every (depth, width) pair), optimizer family, LR, schedule, batch size, total training tokens / steps, data subset, seeds. Report Hyena/SSM FLOPs per token and contrast.

### 2.4 Datasets for evaluating multi-timescale dynamics

Two dataset families are required to span "physical systems vs. generative video vs. synthetic ODE suites". Recommended primary + secondary:

**Primary — Synthetic multi-timescale ODE/SDE suite (full control over ground-truth spectrum):**
- A suite of *known* systems with explicit timescales:
  - **Kuramoto–Sivashinsky** (1D PDE, chaotic, broadband spectrum) — multi-decade power-law decay, classic multi-scale test.
  - **Lotka–Volterra** (limit-cycle, two well-separated timescales: fast prey oscillations, slow predator envelope).
  - **Damped harmonic oscillator with two superposed modes** at $f_1, f_2$ with $f_2 = 8 f_1$ — explicitly checks cross-band transfer.
  - **Navier–Stokes 2D Kolmogorov flow** (intermediate timescale content spanning inertial range).
- Stored as $(x_0, x_1, ..., x_T)$ trajectories of length $T = T_{\text{train}}$ during training; held-out evaluation rolls to $T_{\text{eval}} = k T_{\text{train}}$ for $k \in \{2, 4, 8\}$.

**Secondary — Video prediction data with easily characterizable motion scales** *(uncertainty: requires download or local generation; flag if blocked by network)*:
- **Moving MNIST with two-speed motion** (a custom variant: each digit translated at a slow and a fast velocity, overlapping), or
- **Synthetic "two-scale particle field"** as a fully-self-generated substitute if no video data is downloadable.

**Rationale:** synthetic ODE/SDE suite is the only way to *measure* spectral fidelity at known band positions with ground truth; video adds realism but is hard to score at arbitrary horizons without large dedicated infrastructure. Both are kept in the design so that a one-sided failure (e.g., synthetic-only generalization) cannot invalidate the conclusion.

### 2.5 Training protocol — matched everything

- **Models.** Two scale points: a small (≈ depth ≈ 6, hidden ≈ 384, heads/Hyena order ≈ 6–8) and a medium (≈ depth 12, hidden ≈ 768). Same scale for all conditions at a given scale point.
- **Parameter matching.** For each scale, tune `width` or Hyena `kernel_length`/`order` so that total non-embedding parameters are within ±5%. Report exact deltas.
- **Compute matching.** Approximate FLOPs/token (attention path vs. Hyena path) reported and matched to within ±10% by width adjustments; total **gradient-update tokens** identical across conditions.
- **Optimizer.** AdamW(β=(0.9, 0.999), wd=0.1), peak LR with linear warmup 5% then cosine decay; same schedule for all conditions.
- **Batch size.** Fixed; reported globally.
- **Epochs / steps.** Until the attention control plateaus on a short-horizon validation NRMSE ± a small tolerance (early-stopping criterion shared across conditions, not cherry-picked per condition). Report total step count.
- **Mixed precision / compilation.** Identical (or none if CPU-only): record the choice.
- **Seeds.** ≥3 seed runs per (condition × scale × dataset). Recorded alongside code hashes, data hashes, environment info.
- **Length generalization.** Train at $T_{\text{train}}$, evaluate at $\{T_{\text{train}}, 2 T_{\text{train}}, 4 T_{\text{train}}, 8 T_{\text{train}}\}$.

### 2.6 Evaluation metrics

Quantitative battery, all computed against held-out ground-truth trajectories:

1. **Long-horizon rollout error.** Per-step NRMSE = $\lVert \hat x_{t+k} - x_{t+k} \rVert / \lVert x_{t+k} \rVert$, vs. $k$. Plot log-error-vs-$k$ and fit slope (Lyapunov-style empirical divergence rate).
2. **Spectral fidelity.** Per-trajectory FFT: log-power spectrum, then L1 error to ground truth in three octaves (low / mid / high), plus Wasserstein-1 between empirical and reference spectral densities.
3. **Multi-timescale temporal consistency.** Autocorrelation residual: $|\hat R_{xx}(\tau) - R_{xx}(\tau)|$ at lags $\tau$ chosen to match the dominant system timescales; report the worst-octave statistic.
4. **Distributional metrics.** FID and FVD computed on the **distribution of generated trajectories** vs. real trajectories, using a fixed pretrained I3D/FVD backbone extracted at setup time (small 3D-CNN that runs on CPU if no GPU).
5. **Stability diagnostics.** No NaNs / explosion rate over 1000 long-rollout seeds; reported.
6. **Statistical tests.** Paired bootstrap (10 000 resamples, stratified by seed) for matched-condition differences; 95% CIs on every reported number. Holm–Bonferroni correction across the metric family to control family-wise false-positive rate.

### 2.7 Analysis plan — ablations and stress tests

1. **Causal Hyena variant (`SiT-hyena-C`)** — tests H4 (necessity of non-causality).
2. **Sequence-length extrapolation** at $k \in \{2,4,8\}$ — tests H3.
3. **Depth sweep:** small vs. medium scale point — sensitivity to scale.
4. **Width sweep** at fixed depth — capacity effects.
5. **Kernel-length sweep** for Hyena (e.g., $L_k \in \{64, 128, 256\}$) — does effective receptive field track the longest timescale?
6. **Order-of-blocks ablation:** space-first / time-first vs. the SiT default — isolates whether the operator interacts with block order.
7. **Computation-matched vs. parameter-matched** view — clarifies whether Hyena's win is via larger effective receptive field or via cheaper dense mixing.

### 2.8 Optional reporting

- Aggregate tables side-by-side per dataset, per scale, per evaluation horizon, with CIs.
- Qualitative panels: long rollout vs. ground truth at $8 \times T_{\text{train}}$; per-band spectral overlays.
- Compute ledger to make "matched compute" post-hoc-falsifiable.

---

## 3. Assumptions, dependencies, and uncertainties (explicit)

**Assumptions** (recorded so they can be challenged):
1. Principal operator swap site is SiT's **time-axis self-attention** block, not spatial attention. (Setup-4 detail to confirm with source.)
2. Original SiT time attention is **bidirectional** at training time, so "non-causal Hyena" is meaningfully distinct from causal SSM controls. (Setup-5 detail; if SiT time attention is causal, pivots to a masked-attention referent — see U2.)
3. Matched-compute via matched total **training tokens** is acceptable substitute for matched wall-clock (CPU-only here).
4. FVD computed with a small CPU 3D-CNN if no I3D reachable; absolute FVD not benchmarked to literature, but *within-experiment* comparisons remain valid.
5. Parameter-matching tolerance ±5% and FLOPs tolerance ±10% are locked at design time.

**Dependencies** (must be resolved before/during execution):
- D1. A SiT reference implementation (or hand-written minimum). If absent, experiment cannot run.
- D2. A Hyena operator implementation (causal + non-causal) supporting kernel-length configuration and parameter counting.
- D3. Compute budget and wall-clock cap. Not specified — required to fix scale-point sizes.
- D4. Data access: download path for video data (uncertain given network disabled); synthetic ODE suite generated locally with fixed seeds.
- D5. Number of seeds and matching tolerances locked at design-time, not loosened later.

**Uncertainties** (genuine, surfaced for the researcher):
- U1. Whether to build on an existing SiT repo or hand-write the model from scratch is unclear. Recommendation: use existing if reachable; fall back to hand-written minimum. (Setup-4.)
- U2. Whether SiT's time-axis attention is causal or non-causal in the released implementation is unclear. If causal, "non-causal Hyena" must be re-framed against a causal-attention baseline plus causal-Hyena control. (Setup-5.)
- U3. Empirical outcome is genuinely unknown. The design avoids predicting a winner; all four hypotheses can be falsified.
- U4. The 60-step actor budget and 24-CPU CPU-only environment constrain any future "smoke test" runs to small models and very short horizons. A full-scale CPU smoke-test plan is deliberately out of scope.
- U5. FVD with few long-horizon video samples is fragile; spectral/NRMSE metrics are the primary endpoints if FVD is unreliable.

---

## 4. What I will not do (per the design-only constraint)

- Will not install dependencies, attempt training, fetch pretrained weights, or run any forward pass.
- Will not invent or simulate numerical outcomes, plots, or "p-values".
- Will not mark `task.json` as a completed experiment.

**Awaiting researcher approval** before producing the full design (`stage=result`). Please confirm or amend: (i) the time-attention swap site (setup-4), (ii) SiT time-attention causality (setup-5), (iii) optional inclusion of `SiT-mamba` causal SSM baseline given compute constraints, (iv) whether matched-compute via matched total training tokens is acceptable.

## (а) Состояние `/workspace` и среды

**Файлы.** В `/workspace` ровно один объект — `task.json`, 511 байт. Скрытых файлов, подкаталогов, артефактов чужих наработок нет. `find /workspace -type f` возвращает единственный путь.

**`track.md`.** На диске отсутствует. Существует только как виртуальный документ внутри `task.json` (`documents.track.md`) с содержимым ровно:
> "Design-only task; repositories and compute are not required."

То есть следов чужого кода по SiT / Hyena / диффузионным трансформерам / траекторным задачам в `/workspace` нет вообще. Никаких конфигов, чекпойнтов, README, весов, датасетов.

**Среда исполнения.**
- Хост: Linux 7.0.0-38-generic, x86_64; пользовательский bubblewrap.
- Python 3.12.3 (`/usr/bin/python3`), pip 24.0 — системные.
- CPU: 24 потока; RAM 125 ГиБ, swap 61 ГиБ.
- ML-пакеты не преинсталлены: `pip3 list | grep -iE "torch|jax|flax|haiku|equinox|optax|numpy|scipy|einops|transformers|datasets"` — пусто, exit=1.
- Сеть выключена: `curl --max-time 3 https://pypi.org` → «Could not resolve host». `pip install` / `git clone` заведомо не сработают; окружение не чиню, как и просили.
- GPU: нет — подтверждено по контексту; `nvidia-smi` не запускал.

**Вывод по среде.** Любой *исполненный* эксперимент здесь физически невозможен: нет ни фреймворка, ни репозиториев SiT/Hyena, ни датасета траекторий, ни GPU, ни сети. Это согласуется с `track.md`: задача design-only. Никаких «прогонов» или «результатов» в этом раунде я не симулирую.

**Данные из контекста, которые принимаю как данность, а не как свои выводы** (п. 6 вашего сообщения):
- Целевой объект сравнения — два сетапа: **S1** = SiT с оригинальным time attention (предположительно каузальным по оси t-токенов) и **S2** = SiT с не-каузальным Hyena-оператором, замещающим этот модуль.
- Тезис проверки: даёт ли S2 более длинные, согласованные, мульти-масштабные траектории, чем S1.

**Что из контекста не задано и подвешено** (важно для выбора подхода): природа «траектории» (физическая динамика, видео, motion-capture, 1D-сигнал), бюджет обучения, сетап инференса, метрика «consistent», длина контекста `L`, идентичность конфигов, baseline-процедуры фиксации seed/гиперпараметров, и *по какой именно оси* ставится Hyena (по оси t-токенов или по оси патчей/позиций траектории) — это разные эксперименты, см. (б2).

---

## (б) Кандидаты подхода — 3 варианта, в рамке, без полного дизайна

Все три проходят тест «можно ли сравнить S1 vs S2 честно» и различаются тем, *что именно* ставим главной переменной и *где* ожидаем эффект.

### Кандидат A — «Диагностический toy на синтетической мульти-масштабной динамике»

**Суть.** Управляемая игрушечная динамика (Lorenz-96 / switching-ODE / сумма гармоник с известным спектром). Диффузия / flow-matching по самой траектории; ось t как обычно. Переключаем только модуль, агрегирующий информацию *вдоль оси последовательности траектории*. Длины траекторий `T ∈ {64, 256, 1024, 4096}`. Сетка t-токенов фиксирована.

**За.**
- Полная интерпретируемость: знаем истинный спектр и истинные «масштабы», можем напрямую измерить, какие из них сохранились.
- Лёгкий подбор гиперпараметров; слабая зависимость от случайности данных.
- Изолирует ровно интересующий механизм (замена оператора вдоль одной оси), без шума датасета и сложной архитектуры.

**Против.**
- Внешняя валидность к «реальным длинным траекториям» ограничена.
- Не отвечает на вопрос, как поведёт себя полноразмерный SiT на ImageNet-видео; перенос не гарантирован.

### Кандидат B — «Полный SiT-чекпойнт, два варианта, long-horizon видео/MoCap»

**Суть.** Каноничный траекторный бенчмарк с явно выраженной мульти-масштабной структурой (KTH-actions / UCF-101 на длинных клипах / расширенный Moving-MNIST / Human3.6M-фрагменты). Обучить SiT двух вариантов блока time-mixing с идентичным FLOPs / параметрами / числом токенов. Метрики — FVD, LPIPS, попериодная развёртка ошибки roll-out'а, multi-band FID (низкие/средние/высокие частоты во временном Фурье).

**За.**
- Прямой ответ на «продакшен»-вопрос; внешне валидно.
- Проверяет, переносится ли компактный выигрыш модуля в реальные перцептуальные и временные улучшения.

**Против.**
- Тяжёл по compute (несколько суток обучения даже для одного сида на A100/H100).
- Конфаундеры: стратегия space-time patchification, adaLN-Zero, class conditioning — их надо отдельно фиксировать и описывать.
- В нашей среде запустить нельзя; описание остаётся «как есть, без чисел» — минус к конкретности.

### Кандидат C — «Абляция оператора смешения *по оси t-токенов*, отвязанная от данных»

**Суть.** Изоляция именно *каузальности* оператора. Четыре варианта блока time-mixing с одинаковой параметрической ёмкостью и рецептивным полем: (1) causal time attn, (2) causal Hyena, (3) non-causal Hyena, (4) non-causal attn (decoy как верхняя граница по mixing capacity). Данные — 1D-сигнал с двумя явно разделёнными масштабами (быстрый шум + медленный тренд). Число уровней дискретизации t-сетки `K ∈ {8, 32, 128, 512}`, шаг интегратора фиксирован. Метрики — NLL по уровням шума, попериодная ошибка score'а, время обучения до сходимости, провал стабильности (NaN/Inf, спектральный взрыв у Hyena).

**За.**
- Самый чистый факторный дизайн: изолирует *оператор* и *каузальность* независимо.
- Даёт ответ на ключевую теоретическую тревогу (см. допущения) — ломает ли non-causality оценку score'а.
- Самый дешёвый по compute.

**Против.**
- Самый «далёкий» от заявленной формулировки — отвечает на механизм, а не на end-task.
- Риск переноса выводов на полный SiT со всеми трюками ограничен.

**По двум другим пунктам рамки:**
- «Граница длинной траектории → разваливающийся генератор»: попериодная ошибка roll-out'а vs горизонт `H` + точка отказа (gate: «NLL > baseline + 2σ» или «rollout RMSE > ϵ»).
- «Мульти-масштабность»: спектральная ошибка — энергия в низких/средних/высоких окнах относительно истинной, плюс band-wise consistency отдельно по каждому масштабу.
- **Общие контроли, обязательные во всех трёх:** одинаковое число параметров, одинаковые lr / schedule / seed, одинаковая инференс-схема, фиксированный шаг t-сетки, фиксированный SDE/solver, runs на >1 seed, обязательный placebo-вариант (non-causal attention) как верхняя оценка mixing capacity.

**Если нужно личное чтение прямо сейчас (без фиксации в дизайне):** C — лучший по чистоте сигнала и по дешевизне, плюс закрывает концептуальный риск про каузальность score'а. Если важнее end-task значимость — B. A — компромисс.

---

## (в) Допущения и неопределённости

См. ниже в полях `assumptions` и `uncertainties` структурированным списком. Главное:

- Вопрос «каузальный ли score по t» критичен: если каузальный, non-causal Hyena по оси t-токенов теоретически видит будущие уровни шума при оценке score'а на данном уровне — это не «улучшение», а нарушение контракта обучения flow-matching / denoising. Поэтому в кандидате C non-causal Hyena ставится *по другой оси* (по патч-оси траектории) — сознательный выбор, требующий подтверждения.
- В среде с 24 CPU и без GPU запустить что-либо из описанного нельзя. Никаких чисел/графиков в этом цикле; дизайн — спецификация для запуска в нормальной среде.

Готова перейти к полному дизайну после выбора кандидата (A/B/C) и явного ответа по каузальности score'а по оси t.

Причины: A — вялый, выводов про реальные траектории почти нет; B — самый внешне валидный, но в дизайн-only режиме без compute/датасета он превращается в «описание мечты», без чисел и метрик я от него отказываюсь. C даёт самую чистую факторную структуру: оператор × каузальность при контролируемой ёмкости, на сигнале, где истинный спектр известен, и метрики можно посчитать аналитически. (2) Ось замены. Я фиксирую так: «time attention» в формулировке вопроса трактуется как механизм смешения вдоль оси траектории (внутри сэмпла, т.е. по patch/position-токенам вдоль пространственно-временной оси), а не вдоль диффузионной оси t. Обоснование: «длинные согласованные траектории» и «мульти-масштабная динамика» живут на оси траектории; замена по диффузионной оси t меняет сходимость скоринг-функции и число шагов солвера, но не добавляет согласованности во времени. Это твоё дизайн-допущение A2 — подтверждаю. Дополнительно добавь в факторную сетку маленький вспомогательный 2×2 на оси t (causal attn / non-causal Hyena × horizon) как треангуляцию: там ожидание — отсутствие или минус-эффект на когерентность траектории (потому что non-causal по t видит будущие уровни шума); это подтвердит, что основной сигнал локализован именно на оси траектории. Предупреждение к A2 нужно явно проиграть в анализе: на оси t non-causal Hyena нарушает контракт обучения flow-matching / denoising (оценка скор на уровне шума σ_t получает неявный доступ к информации о σ_{t+k}), поэтому любой «выигрыш» там — артефакт, а не улучшение. Зафиксируй это как failure mode в секции угроз валидности. (3) Домен сигнала — синтетический, спектр известен. Выбирай между (i) смесью 2–4 гармоник с известной частотой плюс медленный тренд плюс розовый шум, или (ii) Lorenz-96 с K=20 мод и известным разделением fast/slow. По умолчанию бери (i) — дешевле, спектр буквально задан руками, band-wise метрики вычисляются точно; (ii) держи как опциональную репликацию. Каналов 1, дискретизация фиксирована. (4) Факторная сетка основного эксперимента — 4 варианта блока time-mixing при выровненной параметрической ёмкости (±5–10%): (a) causal time attn, (b) non-causal time attn, (c) causal Hyena, (d) non-causal Hyena. (b) играет роль placebo для разделения эффектов «каузальность» и «оператор». Выравнивание ёмкости — аналитическое по числу обучаемых параметров; опиши методику ровно: размерность голов, число голов, длина фильтра Hyena (L_h), depth модели. Если выравнивание по FLOPs не сходится с выравниванием по параметрам — фиксируй приоритет параметров и укажи дельту по FLOPs в таблице. (5) Длины траекторий — T ∈ {64, 256, 1024, 4096}. T=64 — sanity floor, T=1024 — основная рабочая точка («длинная»), T=4096 — stress horizon; покажи кривые всех метрик относительно T. Семплов на T — зафиксируй конкретное число, не диапазон; рекомендую начинать с 50k траекторий × 4096 шагов для train, 10k held-out для eval, и обосновать выбор (степень покрытия спектральных полос). (6) Метрики — четыре семейства, все вычислимы в closed form на синтетике: (M1) NLL отдельно по трём спектральным полосам (low/mid/high, границы укажи в долях Найквиста); (M2) spectral energy error per band, |Ê_b − E_b^*|; (M3) авторегрессионный rollout-RMSE как функция горизонта H ∈ {1, 16, 64, 256, 1024} с gate «failure» при RMSE > ε (ε укажи численно); (M4) время до сходимости в часах GPU и стабильность (доля шагов с NaN/Inf, спектральный взрыв у Hyena — отдельная подсекция в угрозах валидности). Дополнительно — multi-band consistency: корреляция между предсказанной и истинной фазой внутри каждой полосы (phase coherence). (7) Обучение — единый lr/schedule/optimizer/seed-протокол для всех 4 вариантов; ≥3 seed'а на ячейку; solver зафиксирован (Euler / Heun, шаги, SNR-расписание) и зафиксирован flow-matching objective в формулировке (линейный / cosine). Все гиперпараметры — таблицей. (8) Стат-тесты — pre-register пороги: чтобы заявить «non-causal Hyena даёт более длинные согласованные мульти-масштабные траектории», требуется одновременно (a) M1 не хуже baseline + 1σ на полосах mid и high при T≥1024, (b) M3-rollout H=256 не хуже baseline + 1σ, (c) M4-стабильность не хуже. Если хотя бы одно не выполнено — заявка отвергается, формулировка выводов остаётся осторожной. Failure mode'ы зафиксируй отдельно: (i) спектральный взрыв у Hyena при T>1024, (ii) утечка по t-оси из A2, (iii) эффект «placebo (b) показывает то же — значит, дело в каузальности, а не в операторе», (iv) эффект «(b) и (d) лучше (a) и (c) — значит, любая двунаправленность помогает, Hyena как таковой ни при чём». Под каждый — заранее прописанный диагностический тест. (9) Feasibility — спецификация под один прогон на 1×A100/H100, целевой бюджет ≤7 GPU-дней на всю сетку, ORCID-уровневая оценка памяти и FLOPs на токен с конкретными числами для каждого из 4 вариантов при T=4096 (max). Без подгонки под реальную машину — это проектировочные числа, не прогноз. (10) Композиция финального документа — следующие секции в указанном порядке: вопрос → гипотезы H0/H1 (явно) → домен и данные → архитектура S1 и S2 с диффом по блоку → дизайн-параметры с таблицей → ablation grid → метрики с формулами → протокол обучения → протокол eval → pre-registered критерии решения → failure modes и их диагностика → feasibility и бюджет → референсы (только если ты уверен в источнике, иначе пусто). Никаких прогнозов результатов, «вероятно», «скорее всего» — формулировки нейтральные, дизайн-only. По объёму — компактно, без воды, формулы только если они несут дизайн-смысл. Переходи к основной работе. В этом раунде результат НЕ нужен; жду полный дизайн в следующем сообщении.
